# parallel_rdp: paraLLEl-RDP, the Nintendo 64 RDP on Vulkan compute, as a static library for the N64 runtime's GPU RDP
# (consoles/n64/runtime/n64_rdp_vk.cpp, XBA-173). Not our code: vendored from
# https://github.com/Themaister/parallel-rdp-standalone at 388d70f5835b352d841d9d9e5a08c5de01470f41 (2024-11-09, the
# standalone tree generated from Themaister/parallel-rdp 1cecd042b2619bc505c12bfdc713808386f2b54d, see COMMIT), trimmed
# and patched as README.md says; this file replaces the upstream config.mk. Licences (NOTICE in README.md):
#   parallel-rdp/      MIT, Themaister (LICENSE)
#   vulkan/, util/     MIT, Hans-Kristian Arntzen (Granite; each file's header, vulkan/LICENSE.Granite)
#   volk/              MIT, Arseny Kapoulkine (end of volk/volk.h)
#   vulkan-headers/    Apache-2.0, The Khronos Group (vulkan-headers/LICENSE.md, LICENSE.Apache-2.0.txt)
# Vulkan itself is loaded at run time by volk (dlopen of libvulkan): nothing links libvulkan, so a host without
# Vulkan still runs (n64_rdp falls back to the software RDP).
#
# volk's globals (vkCreateInstance & co., volkInitialize...) are renamed prdp_* in every file of this library and in
# the code that includes its headers (the forced include prdp_volk_rename.h, generated below from volk/volk.h), so a
# second volk in the same binary (the LSFG bridge's, src/framegen/lsfg_vulkan.cmake) never clashes with this one.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

if(TARGET parallel_rdp)
    return()
endif()
enable_language(CXX)

set(_prdp ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
set(_rename ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/prdp_volk_rename.h)
file(STRINGS ${_prdp}/volk/volk.h _volk_vars REGEX "^extern PFN_vk[A-Za-z0-9_]+ vk[A-Za-z0-9_]+;")
file(STRINGS ${_prdp}/volk/volk.h _volk_funcs REGEX "^[A-Za-z].* volk[A-Z][A-Za-z]*\\(")
set(_names "")
foreach(_l IN LISTS _volk_vars)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^extern PFN_vk[A-Za-z0-9_]+ (vk[A-Za-z0-9_]+);.*" "\\1" _n "${_l}")
    list(APPEND _names ${_n})
endforeach()
foreach(_l IN LISTS _volk_funcs)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^.* (volk[A-Z][A-Za-z]*)\\(.*" "\\1" _n "${_l}")
    list(APPEND _names ${_n})
endforeach()
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _names)
list(LENGTH _names _count)
if(_count LESS 600)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "parallel_rdp: only ${_count} volk symbols found in volk/volk.h")
endif()
set(_text "/* Generated by third_party/parallel-rdp/CMakeLists.txt from volk/volk.h: volk's globals renamed prdp_*. */\n")
string(APPEND _text "#ifndef PRDP_VOLK_RENAME_H\n#define PRDP_VOLK_RENAME_H\n")
foreach(_n IN LISTS _names)
    string(APPEND _text "#define ${_n} prdp_${_n}\n")
endforeach()
string(APPEND _text "#endif\n")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT ${_rename} CONTENT "${_text}")

add_library(parallel_rdp STATIC
    parallel-rdp/command_ring.cpp
    parallel-rdp/rdp_device.cpp
    parallel-rdp/rdp_dump_write.cpp
    parallel-rdp/rdp_renderer.cpp
    parallel-rdp/video_interface.cpp
    vulkan/buffer.cpp
    vulkan/buffer_pool.cpp
    vulkan/command_buffer.cpp
    vulkan/command_pool.cpp
    vulkan/context.cpp
    vulkan/cookie.cpp
    vulkan/descriptor_set.cpp
    vulkan/device.cpp
    vulkan/event_manager.cpp
    vulkan/fence.cpp
    vulkan/fence_manager.cpp
    vulkan/image.cpp
    vulkan/indirect_layout.cpp
    vulkan/memory_allocator.cpp
    vulkan/pipeline_event.cpp
    vulkan/query_pool.cpp
    vulkan/render_pass.cpp
    vulkan/sampler.cpp
    vulkan/semaphore.cpp
    vulkan/semaphore_manager.cpp
    vulkan/shader.cpp
    vulkan/texture/texture_format.cpp
    util/arena_allocator.cpp
    util/logging.cpp
    util/thread_id.cpp
    util/aligned_alloc.cpp
    util/timer.cpp
    util/timeline_trace_file.cpp
    util/environment.cpp
    util/thread_name.cpp
    volk/volk.c)
target_compile_features(parallel_rdp PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(parallel_rdp SYSTEM PUBLIC ${_prdp}/parallel-rdp ${_prdp}/volk ${_prdp}/vulkan
                           ${_prdp}/vulkan-headers/include ${_prdp}/util)
# PARALLEL_RDP_HOST_RDRAM_BSWAP32: our RDRAM is in the N64's byte order (README.md, patches). VK_NO_PROTOTYPES: every
# Vulkan call goes through volk's (renamed) pointers.
target_compile_definitions(parallel_rdp PUBLIC VK_NO_PROTOTYPES PARALLEL_RDP_HOST_RDRAM_BSWAP32)
target_compile_options(parallel_rdp PUBLIC "SHELL:-include ${_rename}")
target_compile_options(parallel_rdp PRIVATE -w) # not our code: keep it quiet
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    target_compile_options(parallel_rdp PRIVATE -O2) # the command thread and the coherency copies run every frame
endif()
set_target_properties(parallel_rdp PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(parallel_rdp PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(ANDROID)
    find_library(PRDP_LOG log)
    target_link_libraries(parallel_rdp PUBLIC ${PRDP_LOG}) # Granite's LOGE / LOGI go to logcat
endif()
